subject: RE-SCOPED s378: NOT offsets and NOT pos()/\G — regex interpolation DROPS direct subscripts ($a[i], $h{k}); needs perl's intuit_more heuristic
description:
FABLE HALF DONE s382: Pl/InterpScan.pm shipped — scan/scan_one event API + line-faithful intuit_more/regcurly ports from perl 5.40.3 toke.c/regcomp.c, verified by Pl/t/interp-scan-01.t (180 rows).

CONSUMER 1 DONE s382f (Opus) — the regex-pattern interpolator, which IS #237. `ExprToCL::_gen_interp_regex_pattern`'s private walk is DELETED (the ruled acceptance bar); it and the `_has_regex_interpolation` gate both go through `Pl::InterpScan::scan(…, in_regex => 1)`. Each event is lowered by COMPILING ITS OWN SOURCE TEXT AS CODE through the expression pipeline (`_compile_ref_text_form`) rather than a second lowering table — one shape fast-pathed to its atom (plain unqualified non-magic scalar, no chain); `@`-sigil results join with `$"`; an unlowerable reference DIES (rule 12). Guards: Pl/t/regex-interp-01.t (28 shapes re-derived from live perl AT TEST TIME + 5 emission rows). clform-01.t t68's expectation rewritten under the s377 four-conjunct rule (it pinned the walk's non-dereferencing `(p-gethash $r "k")`) + strengthened with the `p-aref-deref` sibling. Cache generation v2-129 → v2-130.

REMAINING (contract = docs/interp-scan.md §wiring):
 (2) rename machinery: `_interp_canon`/`_interp_names` filter events; `_interp_fixer` becomes name_span splices (also fixes its probed-wrong `${x}[`-is-@-family arm); then `%canon_pat` in `_block_captures_name`, `ExprToCL2::_string_literal_form`, VarAnnotator's three quote scans. Gate per port: corpus-diff byte-identical + Pl/t (+ sweep when lib/ shims are reachable).
 (3) StringInterpolation via scan_one, per-divergence probe+guard (table §3-§11: $$ar[0], @-[0], ${ x }, $12abc, $::a::b).

Residue from consumer 1 (docs/interp-scan.md §Residue): postderef_qq stays OFF in pattern mode (unchanged behavior; the pattern side would need the NODE, not just the text); ${^TAINT} value divergence → task #293.

Key probed facts (frozen in interp-scan-01.t): {2}/{2,}/{,3}/{ 2, 3 } are QUANTIFIERS; only the FIRST bracket group is classified, continuations always bind; braces CLOSE a reference in both modes; the weigher's known_name (gv) hook is real ([\n@foo] flips); only 1-2 digit guts are subscripts ([100] is a charclass); @+/@- never interpolate in patterns, $"/$]/$$/$#x/$+[0] do; regex \c does not hide a following $. #286 stays OUT (classifier is module-level so intuit_curly can sit beside it later).
